audit.check: **No workarounds**: No TODOs, FIXMEs, stubs, or partially-implemented features
audit.evidence: The user explicitly approved nil-as-missing. Matching records selected nodes independently from value qualification; no fixture branches or stubs. Other XSD1.1 semantics are not imported.

audit.check: **Exception safety**: C++ uses `ReferenceHolder` for Qore allocations, `std::unique_ptr` for C++ allocations, `*xsink` checked after every fallible operation
audit.evidence: Owned key objects distinguish nil from absent fields; incomplete sequences exit before comparison/publication. Four allocation positions pass one-shot/persistent failure and recovery, preserving the active context memory-error category. Native Valgrind frees all361 allocations; Qore Valgrind has zero errors/lost bytes.

audit.check: **Thread safety**: All mutable shared state protected by `std::lock_guard<std::mutex>` or documented as immutable-after-construction
audit.evidence: Nil keys and sequences are owned per validation context; multiple constraints share the existing context-owned key. No shared mutable state is added.

audit.check: **Type safety**: Strongly-typed `code<return(args)>` instead of untyped `code`; `static_cast` instead of C casts; typed hashdecls for results; enums where appropriate
audit.evidence: Native enum/pointer types and typed Qore fixture collections are retained. No sentinel addresses, public API or ABI changes.

audit.check: **Performance**: No O(n²) where O(n) is possible; no unnecessary copies; coordinate descent uses incremental residuals not full matrix multiply
audit.evidence: Constant-time nil classification and existing per-field qualification; no added traversal or value copying. One key object per matched node uses existing ownership and storage.

audit.check: **Error handling**: All inputs validated (dimensions, empty data, unfitted models); C++ I/O handles EAGAIN/EINTR if applicable
audit.evidence: 148 cases cover nil/missing/empty values, multiple selected nodes, composite references, defaults, shared fields, invalid nil content and invalid field types. Tests assert exception categories and unchanged DOM content; context reuse and allocation recovery pass.

audit.check: **Documentation**: Doxygen `@param`, `@return`, `@throw` on all public methods; `@par Example` with realistic business scenarios; `@note` for important caveats
audit.evidence: Release notes, README, durable design/examples and explicit interpretation record describe the approved rule and correct the preliminary historical evidence. Native docs build without warnings/errors. No public method is added.

audit.check: **QPP flags**: `[flags=CONSTANT]` on methods that never throw; `[flags=RET_VALUE_ONLY]` on methods that throw but have no side effects
audit.evidence: No QPP method or flags change.

audit.check: **Security**: No user-controlled format strings; no buffer overflows; bounds checking on array indices; no credentials in code
audit.evidence: Constant diagnostic and bounds-checked probe formatting; guarded input/output source hashes; no new external-resource access, credentials or user format strings.

audit.check: **Correctness**: Algorithms verified against reference implementations; edge cases tested (empty data, single sample, all-zero features)
audit.evidence: All148 expected native cases pass497 assertions. Pinned Xerces agrees on119 and retains27 documented nil-keyref differences plus2 root-caused union duplicate-branch defects. Original W3C bytes are verified unchanged and its typed derivative is separately identified. All54 committed-source suites,74 provider tests and17 survey tests pass; four corpus reports remain exactly unchanged. Both Valgrinds are clean.
